conclusion: With amd_iommu=off active, current-production gfx1151 GGUF completes independent right-sized 512/128 and 4K/128 warmup+3 processes exactly. Relative to the July 15 IOMMU-on publication, prefill is directionally higher by 7.41% and 7.44%, while graph decode is higher by 7.81% and 5.37%. The nearly identical prefill deltas are a promising signal, not an IOMMU-causal performance claim: the current runtime source differs materially from the publication commit and the source tree contains 255 disclosed pre-existing untracked benchmark files. A same-commit IOMMU-on control is required before attributing or retaining the uplift. Disabling the AMD IOMMU also makes the amdxdna/NPU driver fail initialization. No 128K workload was run and this result says nothing about the open 128K scheduler lifecycle failure.

iommu_on_reference.comparability_limit: Same hardware/model/HIP/protocol, but hipEngine runtime commit differs materially; use only as a directional reference.

evidence_boundaries: The IOMMU-off run and July 15 IOMMU-on reference use the same machine, model fingerprint, HIP/compiler stack, one-queue process policy, workload shapes, and warmup+3 timing protocol.
The hipEngine measured runtime differs materially between the two commits, so the observed uplift cannot be assigned solely to IOMMU state.
The run occurred in a tracked-clean tree with 255 disclosed pre-existing untracked benchmark result files, so its canonical provenance is dirty and it is not topline eligible.
The 512/1 IOMMU-on current-runtime control at 1160.229 tok/s used a different single-run/no-graph timing shape and is not substituted for the matching publication protocol.
No 128K or larger workload was run; no inference is made about the open queue-retirement stall.
amd_iommu=off disables amdxdna/NPU initialization on this platform and therefore carries a functional tradeoff outside HIP GPU inference.

decision.production_recommendation: Do not promote based on this cross-commit diagnostic alone.
decision.required_next_gate: Reboot with IOMMU enabled and run the identical current-commit 512/128 and 4K/128 warmup+3 commands; if the delta remains material, optionally reboot back to IOMMU off for an ABA confirmation.
decision.requires_user_approval: Yes; another boot and benchmark are required.
